dialogue.text: Of course. I'm sorry for the inconvenience. I'll check it right away.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe. Keɗi na saboda wannan damuwa. Zan duba shi da sauƙi.

scenario: Talking about a recent film or book
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ana yarda da filman da fasaha.
Yar'ad da 'good'.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I watched a new film last night. It was very good!
dialogue.translation: Na duba wata filin sabuwar da dare. Ya kasance mai kyau!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Oh really? What's the story about?
dialogue.translation: Yaushe? Me yake wata fasaha?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: It's about a man who travels back in time. But the end is a bit strange.
dialogue.translation: Yake game da wani mutum da ya koma da zamanin baya. Amma farkon ya kasance mai matsalarwa.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds interesting. I only read the book, not the film.
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya dace. In da kawai na karanta littafi, ba filin ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: The film is better than the book, I think. But then I haven't read it.
dialogue.translation: Filin ya fi littafin kyau, in tun da na ganin. Amma bayan haka ba zan karanta ba ne.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: After I finish my exams, I'll watch it. Thanks for the recommendation!
dialogue.translation: Bayan na kammala jarrabawa, zan duba shi. Na gode da shawara!

key_phrases.phrase: The end is a bit strange

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good morning. I have a few questions for you. First, why do you want this job?
dialogue.translation: Barka da yamma. Ina da wasu tambayoyi don ka. Farawa, meyasa kana son wannan aiki?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I really like working with people, and I have some experience in customer service.
dialogue.translation: Da yawa na son aiki tare da mutane, kuma ina da wasu tunani a matsayin sabis da kwarewa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I see. Also, can you work on weekends?
dialogue.translation: Na gani. Kuma, za ka iya aiki a kwanaki na matsayi?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that is possible. I can work on Saturdays and Sundays.
dialogue.translation: Iye, wannan za a iya. Zai iya aiki a ranar Sabtu da Litinin.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Good. When can you start?
dialogue.translation: Lafiya. Yaushe za ka fara?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I can start next week because I need to give notice at my current job.
dialogue.translation: Zan fara wata guda saboda ina da bukata in bayyana wata sabuwar aiki a cikin wata aiki na yanzu.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: What do you want to eat for dinner?
dialogue.translation: Me yaushe zan so in ci abincin yaushe?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I like pasta, but I don't want anything heavy tonight.
dialogue.translation: Ina dadi da pasta, amma ba zan so wani abu mai zurfi wannan yaushe ba.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: We have some chicken and vegetables in the fridge. That could be good.
dialogue.translation: Muna da wasu kifi da kaya a cikin fridge. Wannan zai iya zama mai kyau.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That sounds nice. But I really want something with more flavor.
dialogue.translation: Wannan ya dace. Amma zan so wani abu mai dacewa da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: How about we make a stir-fry with some rice?
dialogue.translation: Yaya zan zama mu yi da wasu shinkafa?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, that's a good idea. So we can eat it together, and I can help you cook too.
dialogue.translation: I, wannan wata matsalar mai kyau. Saboda haka za mu ci shi tare, kuma zan iya taimaka wa ku kuma.

key_phrases.translation: wani abu mai dacewa da yawa
Zan iya taimaka wa ku kuma

scenario: Asking for help with a computer issue
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Ya se ya yi bayanin tambaya mai zurfi.
Yin amfani da wani abu mai mahimmanci.
Ya nuna cewa wani abu ya dace.
A matsayin yin aiki da na'urori ko computers.
Yin amfani da mouse.
Wata cikin fashe ko na'urar.
Wani abu da ke zabi.
Da rashin 'babu wata ba.
Ya nuna sabon fashe.
Ya nuna dalilai.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Could you help me? I need to use my computer, but the screen is black.
dialogue.translation: Za ka iya taya ni? Ina bukata in yi amfani da na'urar computer, amma filin bayanai yana da haske.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Sure. Let me see. Did you click the right button?
dialogue.translation: Me yaushe. Baka ganin. Ka shiga wata zabta da dace?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Yes, I did. But it doesn't work. Maybe it's broken.
dialogue.translation: Iyawa, na shiga. Amma ba ya yi aiki ba. Maybe ya rasu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Let's try again. Sometimes it works after a few minutes.
dialogue.translation: Baka yi daga nan. Kwanaki da dama ya yi aiki bayan da a zuba da yawa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Okay, I will wait. But, because it's urgent, I need it now.
dialogue.translation: Da yaushe, zan jira. Amma, saboda ya da haske, ina bukata yanzu.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: I see. Let me check the power button. Ah, here! Now it works!
dialogue.translation: Na gane. Baka duba wata zabta mai haske. Ah, nan! Yanzu ya yi aiki!

scenario: Renting an apartment (first inquiry)
frequency_note: words ranked ~300–700 by frequency of English

vocabulary.note: Akan yi da 'alquilar an apartment' (alquilar wani gida).
A cikin turanci na Amurka mai yawa; a turanci na Birtaniya ake cewa 'flat'.
Akan yi da wadansu ko wuraren da suka zama da dama.
Yankin lokaci; da amfani wajen magana game da alquilar wata.
Wani sabon da 'cost'.
Akan yi da wadansu abubuwan da suka zama cikin farashin.
Wani ma'ana shine 'saduwa', amma a nan shine matsayin gida.
Ya nuna yankin da yawa a wani wuri.
Don nuna matsayin lokaci ko wuri.
Ya nuna damuwa ko damuwa.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Hello, I want to rent an apartment. Is it available now?
dialogue.translation: Sannu, ina son in alquilar wani apartamento. Yaushe ya zama da dama?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Yes, it is available. The rent is 800 dollars per month.
dialogue.translation: Iyo, ya zama da dama. Alquilar ya fi 800 dala a wata.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: Does that price include water and electricity?
dialogue.translation: Wannan farashin ya hadamar da ruwa da mai iska?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: No, it includes only water. Electricity is extra.
dialogue.translation: Ba, ya hadamar da ruwa kawai. Mai iska ya fi.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: And what floor is it on? Is it near a supermarket?
dialogue.translation: Da matsayin da ya kasance? Ya kusa da supermarket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: It's on the third floor, and it's between two big supermarkets. Maybe you can visit it tomorrow.
dialogue.translation: Ya kasance a matsayin na uku, da ya tsakannin supermarket biyu masu girma. Ba zan tabbata ba za ka iya ziyarta shi gobe.

key_phrases.translation: Yaushe ya zama da dama yanzu?
